title: AI Firm Lovo Reportedly Accused of Illegally Replicating [person]' Voices

behaviors.text: Two [person], [person] and [person], are reportedly suing AI start-up Lovo for allegedly creating and promoting unauthorized clones of their voices.
Lovo's synthetic voices were allegedly discovered in various media, including a podcast and promotional videos.
The [person] claim they were misled into providing voice samples, which were then allegedly used without consent, violating trademark and privacy laws.
